record.question: Fill in the blanks: (a) Periodic patta without validity shall be deemed to expire after _________ years from the date of commencement of the MLR Act, 2013 unless renewed. (b) The area of house pass per family to be allotted by the Village Council will not exceed _________ square metre. (c) Any person who failed to comply with the summon to attend as witness may be imposed a fine not exceeding _________ rupees. (d) No reference to MPIB is required in respect of individual or firm or NGO for setting up of industrial unit, etc. if the land applied for is less than _________ bighas. (e) Boundary wall or proper fencing shall be put up by the allottee within _________ months from the date of issue of provisional land lease certificate.
